title: Ruby Stone Song
style: Phonk with a slow head-nod swing, dusty drum knocks, sub-bass pulses, and eerie bell plucks; verse stays sparse and intimate, pre-chorus lifts with filtered claps and rising tape hiss, chorus opens with stacked childlike gang vocals and a gritty chant hook. Whispered doubles, delayed ad-libs, and a few panned melodic flashes between lines. Dark, warm, and polished with a low-end-heavy mix.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ruby, little Ruby
You got a stone in your name
Deep red like a drop of sunset
Held in a fireproof frame

Grown in the dark, then shining
Under a million years of stone
Pressure can make a treasure
That glow like a heart you've known

[Pre-Chorus]
Ruby stone
Old as rain
Born from heat
But still остаин?
